info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程針對複合材料之結構作深入的力學分析，包括纖維微觀力學以及層板力學理論。微觀力學部份是有關纖維的受力與變形關係，在層板力學部份是複合材料層板的應力應變關係，同時也將介紹複合材料破壞理論。
description.describe_eh: This course provides an in-depth study on composite mechanics. The course contains two major parts: the micro-mechanics describing the stress-strain relations of fibers and matrix, and the macro-mechanics describing the relation in laminates. Some failure theories for composite materials are also introduced.
